_readme: AUTHORED STEMS — the recontextualisation layer.
These cards are Hannetjie's, harvested from Canvas quiz captures. Canvas held the
context OUTSIDE the question: a quiz title, a group preamble, an underline, a link.
The harvest took the question and left the context behind, so the card arrives
saying things like 'Complete the passage. (MODULE 1.1)' — a title, not a question.
ONLY THE STEM IS AUTHORED. The answer, the options, the passage, the blanks and the
marking points are untouched and still diff against the capture. The stem is
navigation: it says what you are being asked, using only terms already on the card
or in its own passage. The original is preserved on the card as `qOrig` and the
tool shows it under 'as it appeared in Canvas', so her wording is never lost.
TWO MODES.
q   — full replacement. For stems that carry no content, only a title.
sub — surgical [find, replace] pairs, each of which MUST match exactly once.
Used where the stem is long and mostly correct; retyping 100 words of her
prose to fix one word is how transcription errors get introduced.
KEYED ON THE FULL ckey (type | question | content signature), computed from the
card as it arrives from the harvest. apply-migration rebuilds from source on every
run, so at the moment this overlay runs the question is always the original — the
same reason selfmark-answers.json can key on `q` while writing `a`. Edit the source
question and the key stops matching, which fails the build instead of silently
restemming the wrong card.
CONSEQUENCE, DELIBERATE: rewriting `q` changes the shipped card's ckey, so saved
progress and any flag on these 28 cards resets. That is correct — the card the
reader met is not the card they will meet now.

stems.q: Respiratory terminology — name the condition each description defines.
Flow and pressure vocabulary — name the term each description defines.
Blood pressure = cardiac output × peripheral resistance. Complete what each half depends on, then the chemicals that raise and lower it.
The renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system. Complete the table: what makes each hormone, where it acts, and what it does.
Control of heart rate. Complete the conduction pathway, then the nerves, hormones and electrolytes that speed it up or slow it down.
How venous return, plasma electrolytes, stress and exercise each change cardiac function and blood pressure.
The baroreceptor reflex. Complete both pathways — low blood pressure and high blood pressure — from receptor to effect.
Artery against vein. Complete the comparison of their walls and lumens.
Lagi's ECG. Put the five conduction events in the right order, then describe cardiac muscle fibres.
Lagi's ECG, continued. What anchors the atrioventricular valves, and what does the QRS complex represent?
Lagi's blood pressure is 150/90 and his heart rate is 110. Work through his readings, the artery-and-vein micrograph, and how the body senses pressure and blood chemistry.
Lagi has a murmur between the lub and the dub. Work through what makes the heart sounds, and what mitral regurgitation does.
From the diagram — name the blood vessel labelled X, and say where it returns blood to.
Kalama is choking on a large piece of bread. Name the structure that let it happen, and the ones that normally keep the airway clear.
La'akea's broken rib has punctured her parietal pleura. Name the condition, and the correct term for the collapsed lung.
Oliana has finished exercising and her blood pressure has to come back down. Put the reflex steps in order, then complete the vasomotor half.
A still-born baby's lung tissue sinks in water. Explain why.
Mesenteric adenitis and the MALT system — ten questions on lymphoid tissue, the cells in lymph, and lymphatic drainage.

stems._why: Canvas served this question's text as a single full stop: the raw capture reads `. [[IMG]] [[IMG:...]] [[IMG:...]]`, so the whole stem was carried by images. Two of the three bound (a pulmonary/systemic circuit diagram and a neurovascular-bundle micrograph) and neither states the task. This is the textbook case for a full replacement — a stem carrying no content at all — and the seven statements it is asking about are untouched, so the card still diffs against the capture.
